name: check-agent-health
description: Query agents.db for last run status of all agents, flag any that haven't run in 25+ hours
prompt:
Check all agents health:
sqlite3 /home/cian/git/ai-agents/data/agents.db "SELECT agent, status, started_at, error FROM runs GROUP BY agent HAVING started_at = MAX(started_at) ORDER BY agent;"

Also check crontab: crontab -l | grep ai-agents

Report: last run time+status per agent, any agent not run in 25+ hours, cron installed Y/N, PASS/FAIL summary.
